name: Ultraman Leo
description: After being brutally maimed by evil aliens, Dan Moroboshi (Ultra Seven) takes under his wing a fierce young Ultra-like being from L-77, and christens him "Ultraman Leo," to continue his mission to defend the Earth.

videos.title: Princess Comet Episode 63
videos.overview: Ultraman Leo appears as guest in TBS's live-action drama Princess Comet.

videos.title: The Death of Seven! Tokyo Is Sinking!
videos.overview: Ultraseven is defeated by Alien Magma's pet monsters, the Gillas Brothers. A new Ultraman arrives, one with a dark past....

videos.title: The Big Sink! The Last Day of the Japanese Archipelago
videos.overview: Leo is nearly overwhelmed by the Giras Brothers and Alien Magma, but is saved by Dan. The city is not so lucky.

videos.title: A Farewell to Tears
videos.overview: A mysterious alien begins attacking a brutally killing MAC members. Leo must stop it.

videos.title: A Vow Between Men
videos.overview: Leo is defeated, and Dan trains Gen even harder. Unfortunately, the monster won't wait.

videos.title: Don't Cry! You're a Man
videos.overview: On a lake field trip, the young Toru, along with his little sister Kaoru, who lost his father to the alien Tsuruk, finds it difficult to enjoy being on a picnic in the company of others whose parents are able to be with them.

videos.title: You're a Man! Burn On!
videos.overview: Gen/Leo fails to save a woman, angering her lover. He must train to defeat the new threat.

videos.title: A Beautiful Man's Disposition
videos.overview: Gen is suspicious of the strange flower Kaoru found. Little does anyone realize that the flower is under the control of the evil Kendoros!

videos.title: Certain Kill! Monster Challenger!
videos.overview: Gen saves a civilian but allows the monster to get away. Gen is suspended from MAC and sent to the mountains to train...

videos.title: Bridge of Friendship That Spans Space
videos.overview: Gen enjoys a day off at an amusement park with his friends. However, a space monster called Guiro has taken up residence there...

videos.title: The Wandering Monster of Sorrow
videos.overview: A kaiju arrives and Gen recognizes it as an old friend. Can he defeat it?

videos.title: One Man Covered in Mud
videos.overview: Alien Kettle has come to earth, killing the father of a child. How will he deal with his grief?

videos.title: The Adventure Nut Arrives!
videos.overview: An Aboriginal man may just hold the secret to defeating a monster

videos.title: Huge Explosion! A Desperate Couple of Aliens
videos.overview: After Gen is framed by Alien Vibe, he must discover it's secret to defeat it.

videos.title: Certain-Kill Fists! A Young Boy Calls Upon a Tempest
videos.overview: Leo is defeated by the monster, Antales, when a mysterious boy comes into to the dojo competition and knocks out everyone in it. Who is he?

videos.title: Deadly Designs in Darkness! Attacking With Fighting Spirit
videos.overview: When an alien with the ability to duplicate itself arrives in Tokyo, Gen trains to dodge it's multiple attacks.

videos.title: The Woman Who Faded Into the Night
videos.overview: The dreadful Alien Atler has come to earth, and Dan tells Gen he is no match for this enemy. She also has the power to wipe out entire planets...

videos.title: Bride of the Wolfman
videos.overview: A werewolf stalks young women during the nights. One young girl refuses to stay indoors.

videos.title: Vampire! The Bat Girl
videos.overview: A horde of vampire bats is shot down, and Momoko finds a wounded girl in a field. Tooru suspects something of her.

videos.title: The Revival of the Half-Man Fish
videos.overview: Gen and some friends go to Hokkaido, but the village doesn't allow fishing during the Bon festival. However, the Alien Boze may have been awakened.

videos.title: The Mysterious Boy of the Little Bear
videos.overview: An alien boy arrives on earth, pursued by a monster. MAC must stop it before it murders too many people and kills the gentle Bock.

videos.title: I Saw a Goddess in the Far North
videos.overview: Aliens are after a space goddess. Can Leo save her?

videos.title: The Leo Brothers vs the Monster Brothers
videos.overview: While Leo is engaged in battle with 2 monster brothers, his long-lost brother, Astra arrives to assist him.

videos.title: The Mischievous Alien Who Fell Out of Bed
videos.overview: A mischievous alien falls out of his bed onto Earth where he befriends a group of kids. He shows off his monster, Renbolar, only for one of the kids to pull off his tail that was controlling it, causing it go on a rampage. Can Ultraman Leo stop it until it's master's tail grows back?

videos.title: The Beautiful Virgo Maiden
videos.overview: When their planet is ruined by giant rebellious robots, an alien and her grandfather escape to Earth only to be hunted down by them. Luckily, Leo steps in to help.

videos.title: The Rhinoceros Beetle Is a Space Invader
videos.overview: Evil Aliens use a giant beetle to spread poisonous garbage across Earth. Leo must stop it!

videos.title: Ultraman King vs the Magician
videos.overview: When Leo is shrunk down to a few inches by Pressure, Ultraman King, impressed by his fighting skills, arrives to assist him.

videos.title: Mighty! Momotaro!
videos.overview: A savage alien with a huge appetite for apples come to Earth to eat all of our apples but MAC won't have any of that.

videos.title: The Return of the Bearded Captain!
videos.overview: An alien narrowly escapes death from a group of villagers with the help of a former sea captain. However, the tables turn when the aliens begin to attack the village and matters get even worse when they fuse onto a giant kaiju.

videos.title: Reunion of Fate! Dan and Anne
videos.overview: Dan sees a woman who he believes to be Anne. But the Uringa alien calls her "mother." What is the connection, and is she really Anne?

videos.title: The Monster's Favor
videos.overview: When a boy and his father pull out a gigantic needle that was stuck in a monster's foot, she repays them by working at their shop while the father's injured. While there, she makes special pinwheels out of her feathers. Unfortunately, these attract the vicious Alien Magma, the very alien that destroyed Leo's home planet, who is determined to kill Rolan after she refuses to marry him. This time, Leo can't let him get away!

videos.title: The White Flower That Protects Earth
videos.overview: A mysterious old man comes to Earth with poisonous flowers that put kids in comas. Can Leo stop his evil plans? Can he save the kids?

videos.title: Farewell, Princess Kaguya
videos.overview: A skilled female gymnast has been acting strangely lately. What secret does the moon hold about her?

videos.title: The Leo Brothers vs the Space Demon Alien
videos.overview: When Leo is out-matched by the kaiju, Alien Akumania, his brother returns to help him in battle again.

videos.title: Ultra Brothers, Eternal Vows
videos.overview: Ultraman Jack arrives on Earth to take Seven's Ultra Eye back to the Land of Light for repairs. However, an evil alien gets in his way and it's all-out melee. Leo and Jack fighting together and to top it all off, a new Capsule monster is introduced.

videos.title: I'm a Monster General!
videos.overview: A bratty kid saves an alien from being entrapped in a pot for skipping Monster school on the condition that he does his homework for him. However, this ends up humiliating him when all the answers are wrong. He then tells the little monster to destroy the school which gets him MAC's bad side. Later, MAC find him and chase him until hs grows giant. All he wants to do is go home. Will he ever?

videos.title: Fly Leo Brothers, Save the Space Base!
videos.overview: An astronaut, thought to be dead, comes back to Earth from the deadly Planet Atlanta. However, he is secretly an Alien Atlanta. Leo knows he must defeat it but the alien's lover would be devastated. Can he do it?

videos.title: Mystery! The Mirror in Which the Devil Lives
videos.overview: Kaoru Umeda is kidnapped by Specter under the disguise of her mum. When Gen tries to save Kaoru, she sends Alien Mazaras to Earth. He must defeat them both!

videos.title: Battle! The Leo Brothers vs. the Ultra Brothers!
videos.overview: The evil Alien Barabou disguises himself as Leo's younger brother to retrieve the Ultra Key, meaning the Land of Light and Earth will collide. When "Astra" arrives on Earth, he tells Leo that the Ultra brothers are after him. Will Leo see through his disguise? What will be the fate of the 2 planets?

videos.title: The Leo Brothers and the Ultra Brothers, Time of Victory
videos.overview: Leo discovers the true intentions of "Astra" and must put an end to it.

videos.title: MAC Annihilated! The Flying Saucer Is a Living Creature
videos.overview: A beast under the guise of a Flying Saucer travels from a distant planet to attack Earth. MAC doesn't detect it, and gets all but destroyed.

videos.title: The Saucer Creature from the Evil Planet Is Here!
videos.overview: Tooru and some friends try to attract a flying saucer. Unwittingly, they draw the attention of Black Dome, which had been summoned to earth by Commander Black.

videos.title: The Assassin Is a Flying Saucer
videos.overview: Another saucer, Absorba, has been summoned to earth. Gen suspects it is taking advantage of a boy's kind feelings towards animals.

videos.title: Challenge! The Terror of the Blood-Sucking Saucer
videos.overview: The saucer monster Deemos has been called down to earth by Black Directive, and begins killing the inhabitants of Gen's town. What can the ultra do in this situation?

videos.title: The Shooting Star from Hell
videos.overview: A new saucer creature has arrived on earth, but Tooru's school conflict may get in the way of its destruction.

videos.title: The Phantom Girl
videos.overview: Scientists start investigating Black Star, and Commander Black brings in an assassin to stop them. Meanwhile, Tooru befriends a mysterious girl...

videos.title: The Fighting Leo Brothers! The End of the Flying Saucer Beast
videos.overview: A new powerful saucer creature has been summoned to earth. Two brothers have an encounter with it, but the police refuse to believe a monster is behind their accident.

videos.title: The Girl Who Collects the Stardust of Demons
videos.overview: Black Terrina arrives on earth, scattering pretty shells down upon Japan. Little to the humans know the evil will behind the pretty objects as they collect them.

videos.title: The Giant Bird Saucer Attacks Japan's Archipelago
videos.overview: Gen meets a friend who he broke up with over selfishness. The newest saucer monster may bring their conflict to the centre stage again.

videos.title: The Red Assassin Who Beckons Death!
videos.overview: Tooru mourns his losses and finds a teru teru bozu, unaware it is really Nova in disguise.

videos.title: The Life of Leo! The Miracle of King!
videos.overview: Bunyo has come to earth! He may not have strength, but he's smart, as Leo may soon find out..

videos.title: Goodbye Leo! Journey to the Sun
videos.overview: The most powerful saucer beast is summoned from Black Star. What will be the fate of Leo, and the fate of earth?
